notes.note: Peer-reviewed research exists on this. Kouri et al. (1995, Clinical Journal of Sport Medicine) found drug-free athletes' fat-free mass index plateaus near 25, matching pre-steroid-era Mr. America winners, while steroid users often exceeded it.
notes.claim: There is no definitive scientific research on the so-called natural ceiling for muscle growth.
